component.name: NotePad
component.summary: A native COSMIC clone of Microsoft Notepad

description.p: NotePad is a lightweight plain-text editor that recreates the classic Microsoft Notepad (Windows XP) experience using libcosmic, with support for system, light, and dark color schemes on the COSMIC desktop.
This is an independent implementation and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.

ul.li: Open, edit, and save plain text files
Cut, copy, paste, undo, and redo
Find, replace, and go to a line number
Choose an editor font from the Format menu
Word wrap toggle and a live line/column status bar
Insert the current time and date (F5)
System, light, and dark color schemes

description.p: Rewritten on libcosmic. NotePad is now a native COSMIC application with portal file dialogs, cosmic-config persistence, and system, light, and dark themes from the COSMIC desktop.
Make explicit Light Mode foregrounds deterministic across menus, popups, dialogs, editor chrome, and disabled or selected states when the host Plasma session uses a dark color scheme.
Keep menu text readable in Light Mode on KDE, and make the Find bar closable with a visible accessible button or the Escape key.
Preserve unsaved editor content when a file-open request arrives from a secondary application instance or desktop launcher.
Align the Flatpak with KDE and PySide 6.10, correct the public maker identity, and add release-metadata regression coverage.
Rewritten on Qt 6. Light and dark theming now follows the Kirigami color guidelines: the app honors the system color scheme by default and can be pinned to a light or dark scheme from the View menu.
Initial release of the GTK4 NotePad clone.
